rules.text: If the percentage inscriptions are intended as mutually exclusive product market shares within one complete market, then their total should be compatible with a 100% whole; a total materially above 100% challenges using the displayed values as directly validated exclusive market-share values. This challenge does not apply if the chart uses overlapping, multi-select, or otherwise nonexclusive usage definitions.
